caption: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy broth with noodles and shredded cabbage. A whole boiled egg, chashu pork with caramelized layers, and a white ceramic bowl on a wooden table with grain patterns complete the scene.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with a glossy, caramelized surface, showing distinct layers of fat and lean meat.
A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth and slightly glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface variations.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and shredded cabbage.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle speckles, and slightly raised rim.
